drawings.description: Sous ces lignes, un croquis barré de courbes oscillantes, et un schéma de parabole coupant un segment $[0, 1]$ en deux points.
drawings.kind: struck oscillating curves; parabola cutting a segment [0,1]
drawings.notes: Upper part: pencil oscillating curves inside a rough frame, with a long stroke underneath, all struck (drawn grey, schematised; the inequalities written among them are text). Lower left: a parabola crossing the segment [0,1] in two points, the ends of the segment marked by dots; the labels 0 and 1 are placed after the transcription.

drawings.description: schéma remanié : sous $\gamma = \widehat{\mathbb{Z}}^{*}$ une double flèche verticale, en partie surchargée, le relie à $\gamma_0 = \mathbb{Z}^{*}$ ; sous $(\mathbb{Z}/6\mathbb{Z})^{*}$ une flèche marquée $\chi_2$ ; de $\gamma_0$ partent un long trait souligné et deux flèches obliques vers $\pm 1$, l'une barrée de gribouillis ; l'expression « $\chi_0 = \ldots$ » est surchargée
drawings.notes: Labels as in the transcription: gamma = Z-hat* above, gamma_0 = Z* below, joined by a vertical double arrow (overwritten); a small two-headed arrow to its left; under (Z/6Z)* the arrow marked chi_2; from gamma_0 a long underlining stroke and two oblique strokes towards +-1 (one scribbled over, drawn grey). The overwritten "chi_0 = ..." is left as text in the transcription and not reproduced.

drawings.description: figures. En haut à gauche, un treillis au crayon et à l'encre, en forme de losanges, dont les flèches montent de gauche à droite ; au-dessous et au milieu, un grand treillis encadré d'une courbe fermée, dont les sommets sont $\mathfrak{A}_2 = 1$, $\mathbb{Z}_2$, $\mathfrak{S}_2$, $\mathfrak{S}'_2$, $\mathfrak{S}''_2$, $\mathfrak{S}_{22}$, $\mathfrak{S}^{*}_{22}$, $\mathfrak{A}_3$, $\mathbb{D}_3$, $\mathfrak{S}_3$, $\mathfrak{S}'_3$, $\mathbb{D}'_3$, $\mathbb{Z}_6$, $\mathbb{Z}'_6$, $\widetilde{\mathfrak{S}}_3$, $\widetilde{\mathfrak{S}}'_3$, $\mathfrak{A}_5$, $\mathfrak{S}_5$, avec à gauche un petit losange $\mathbb{D}_4$, $\mathbb{Z}_4$, $\mathbb{D}_2$, $\mathbb{E}_2$ et en dessous $\mathfrak{A}_4$, $\mathfrak{S}_4$, $\mathbb{D}_2$, $\mathbb{D}_4$ ; certaines flèches sont en pointillé. Au milieu, un octaèdre au crayon. À droite, un diagramme d'ensembles : les points $1, 2, 3, 4, 5$ dans des ovales marqués $\mathfrak{S}_2$ (autour de $1, 2$), $\mathfrak{S}'_2$ (autour de $4, 5$), $\mathfrak{S}_3$ et $\mathfrak{S}'_3$
drawings.kind: sheet of subgroup lattices of S5, pencil octahedron, set diagram
drawings.notes: Whole upper half of the sheet. Top left: the lattice of diamonds, its arrows rising left to right (nodes placed, labels left out, as in the transcription which names none). Middle: the pencil octahedron, schematised. Below: the large lattice inside a closed curve, its vertices labelled after the transcription (positions read on the facsimile; the reading of some vertices, e.g. E2 and S*22, is uncertain), plain and dashed arrows placed between node centres; the small diamond D4, Z4, D2, E2 on the left drawn faint; A4, S4 below it are not drawn (they belong to the lower lattice). Right: the set diagram, points 1..5 in ovals S2, S2', S3, S3'. Left out: the text, the boxed isomorphisms, the circled marginal note and its outline, the count table; the lower perspective lattice (described in a \note of the transcription, not by this mark).

figures.what: large lattice in a closed curve

drawings.disagreement: The lower perspective lattice of p. 95 is only in a \note; it is a figure no mark covers.

drawings.description: figures. En haut à gauche, un grand treillis en perspective des classes de sous-groupes de $\mathfrak{S}_5$, repris de la page 95 et mis au net, dont les sommets sont $\mathfrak{A}_2 = 1$, $\mathfrak{S}_2$, $\mathbb{F}_2$, $\mathfrak{S}_2 \times \mathfrak{S}'_2 = \mathfrak{S}_2 \times \mathbb{F}_2$, $\mathbb{D}_2 = \mathbb{F}_2^{2}$, $\mathbb{Z}_4$, $\mathbb{D}_4$, $\mathfrak{S}_3$, $\mathbb{Z}_6$, $\mathbb{D}_3$, $\mathfrak{S}_3 \times \mathfrak{S}''_2$, $\mathfrak{A}_3 = \mathbb{Z}_3$, $\mathfrak{A}_4$, $\mathfrak{S}_4$, $\mathfrak{A}_5$, $\mathfrak{S}_5$, $\mathbb{D}_5$, $\mathbb{Z}_5$ ; les arêtes portent des indices ($2$, $3$, $5$), certaines en pointillé, et une bande ombrée longe le chemin de $\mathfrak{A}_3$ à $\mathfrak{A}_5$. En bas à gauche, des correspondances marquées de doubles flèches : $\mathbb{F}_2 \leftrightarrow \mathbb{Z}/4 \leftrightarrow \mathbb{D}_4 \leftrightarrow \mathfrak{S}_4 \times \mathbb{F}_2$, $\mathbb{D}_2 \leftarrow \mathfrak{A}_4 \leftrightarrow \mathfrak{S}_4$, $\mathbb{D}_3 \leftrightarrow \mathfrak{S}_3 \leftrightarrow \mathbb{D}_3 \leftrightarrow \mathfrak{S}_3 \times \mathfrak{S}''_2$, $\mathbb{D}_5 \leftrightarrow \mathbb{Z}_5$, $\mathbb{Z}_6$, avec des groupes entourés et une ligne biffée ; tout en bas, deux petits schémas : $\mathfrak{S}_3$ au-dessus de $\mathfrak{A}_3$, et un rectangle $\mathfrak{S}_2$ -- $\mathfrak{S}_3$ -- $\mathfrak{S}_3 \times \mathfrak{S}'_3$, $\mathfrak{A}_3$ -- $\mathbb{D}_3$
drawings.kind: perspective lattice of the classes of subgroups of S5, correspondences, two small schemes
drawings.notes: Upper left: the perspective lattice, vertices labelled after the transcription and placed on the facsimile, edges drawn between node centres with the indices 2, 3, 5 that can be read; the shaded band from A3 to A5 is drawn as two curves (shading left out); dotted strokes partly left out. Lower left: the correspondences with double arrows, circled groups circled, the struck line drawn grey and schematised (a scribbled group near S3 x S2'' is left out). Bottom: S3 over A3, and the rectangle S2 -- S3 -- S3 x S3', A3 -- D3. A small arrow with S3 at bottom left, not in the transcription, is drawn. The text on the right (counts of classes, normalisers) is left out.
